I honestly can’t thank Meg and the whole team enough!

For the last 5 years, Trigger has struggled with severe separation anxiety. He couldn’t be left alone in the house at all and slept in our bed every single night because he just couldn’t cope. We’d tried everything before finding Trident – training through Dogs Trust, local trainers, and even a dog psychologist – but nothing gave us the confidence or results we were hoping for.

After just a few weeks with Meg, the difference is unbelievable. Trigger is now crate trained, he’s so much more settled, and we’ve been given the confidence and the tools to continue his training at home. We genuinely feel like we’re enjoying our dog again, and we’ve got a bit of our own life back too.

The support, updates and knowledge have been amazing from start to finish, and for the first time in years I actually feel confident in my dog.

Thank you so much to Meg and the whole team – we can’t recommend you highly enough!

Massive thanks to team at Trident !!! After nearly two years of using different trainers & having nothing stick we decided to send our reactive / very nervous GSD away with them for a month.

It’s now an absolute pleasure to take her out & the program has completely turned our lives around :)

Big big shoutout to Megan, Alicia & Holly - can’t thank these girls enough for training Willow !!!! ❤️

Amazing Company! Amazing Dogs! Couldn’t be happier 👌
Sending a 5 star review from Canada …

Top notch service from begging to end our family always wanted a family person protection dog to add to our clan but was always unsure and had lots of concerns about the whole process…. I can only say that trident exceeded all our expectations. The process was fantastic from beginning to end . We now have the perfect family protector and new member to our family thanks so much for caring 👌

I sent my German Shepard to trident for reactivity problems. I couldn’t ask for more the constant updates through the process and the training was incredible. would definitely recommend them to anyone.

Couldn’t recommend any else! I own a very head strong xl American bully. Shes an absolute sweetheart but pulls like crazy, especially towards other dogs to play. She came back unbothered by dogs and walks like a dream. The team are amazing and always let me know she was getting on well! Thankyou trident team!

I sent my Dog Mika for a full residential course at Trident. To say I’m impressed is an understatement.

The updates I received each week made me feel comfortable. The progression in training was clear.

We have received a different dog from what we sent and we couldn’t be happier.

I highly recommend trident for anyone looking for obedience and behaviour training for their dog.

Big thanks to Dan and Holly who did our handover, the attention to detail was amazing and we really took onboard all the feedback.

A brilliant team and experience with trident. The team are professional, knowledgeable, and genuinely care about the dogs and the families they go to. The standard of training is amazing to see. Would highly recommend 🙌🏼 …

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Outstanding Training & Results

JC K9Security sent one of  they top dogs, Gelu, to Trident Elite Family Protection
Dogs for a month of training, and they did an absolutely amazing job.
Ash and the whole team worked extremely hard, and the results were outstanding. Gelu came back with perfect commands, much more drive, and his bites were truly exceptional.
This is a five-star service from start to finish, and I highly recommend Trident Elite Family Protection Dog to anyone looking for elite-level protection dogs

Thank you again to Ash and the team!

I would like to thank Ash for such a good experience.  We have a wonderful PPD thanks to him and the team at Trident.  She goes everywhere with the family, loves children,  and is great with our other animals.   Very obedient.  Fast on switch if needed.
A few things along the way:
1.  Response time:  I have never texted on WhatsApp and not had a response within 4-6 hour window at most. I don’t  think he gets much sleep.  Also, I have contacted other team members (Dan and Nick) from Trident and they have always responded quickly as well.
2.  At home training:  very thorough.  They allowed us to go at our own pace.  The Trident team worked on all scenarios that we requested.
3.  Our follow up training/visit has been offered but not needed yet.
4.  Health of dog:  We had a full vet check immediately.  She was the perfect weight and no issues noted.  They provided all immunization records for us to take to our vet.
5.  Dog selection: We had 8-10 dogs that we initially discussed after a short interview.  Ash was quick to say no if he didn’t think a dog would work as we talked about each one.  We had it narrowed to two and he said flat out this is the dog for you, and he was correct.
6.  Specialization-  We had a special command that we wanted our dog to have in addition to her regular training and for her to be ready for specific  situations.  They had no problem adding what we asked and sent videos of progress along the way

I reached out to Trident Elite Family Protection Dogs in February 2025, after reviewing other protection dog companies in the United States.  I had recently lost my 12 year old German Shepherd to an acute ruptured spleen.  I had not planned on getting another German Shepherd because of my age and the extensive amount of time that goes into training them.  My initial contact with Trident was by email, and I received an immediate phone call from the owner, Ash.  We talked for over an hour, and I was convinced I wanted to work with him.  We received our dog in April 2025.  He was flown from the UK to Miami Florida, and a team of four (including Ash) delivered him to us in Naples Florida, and spent 4 days working with us.  Filou was three years old (now 4) when we got him.  Receiving a highly trained protection dog sounds and is somewhat intimidating, but the Trident team did everything to help us overcome that feeling.  Four days of being by our side coaching us along the way was invaluable in my opinion.  When they left, we had what we needed to begin bonding with Filou, and Filou to us.  I spend a lot of time by myself, and having a dog that has my back ALL of the time provides me with feeling safe, secure, and confident.  Filou is loyal, unbelievably smart, and loving.  The follow-up I’ve received from Ash has been outstanding.  If I needed Ash, really needed him, I have no doubt he would show up at my door.  Owning a protection dog from Trident is an investment, financially, emotionally and physically.  German Shepherd dogs need and want a job.  We work with Filou every day, putting him through his commands, throwing his favorite ball, and walking him.  It takes time, and it is worth every minute.  If you are on the fence about purchasing a dog from Trident, jump over the fence, you will not regret it.

Unbelievable experience with the Trident team. Ash and team have built a special process that delivers a loving family pet that has a protection switch like I’ve never seen before. Adonis has quickly become a member of our family. Thank you Trident.
Incredible dogs and incredible team. Super professional from start to finish, if your looking for peace of mind and a loyal companion then Trident Elite K9 is who you need! 10/10
The best of the best. Visited from the USA. I would recommend Scott and Chloe to anyone serious about dogs.

I cannot express enough how thrilled I am with the exceptional service and the seamless three-day handover process provided by Trident Protection Dogs for our new guardian, Axel. As soon as we made the decision to invest in a protection …
Highly professional service and everyone is so knowledgeable, friendly and very helpful. Really great experience. 100% recommended these guys, they really know what they are doing.
